title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
reason: Materially escalates the covered hack story with new facts — a wider breach, erased evidence, named CEO statement, and a withdrawal-restart and proof-of-reserves timeline.

sources.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

title: Binance arranges $6.34 billion to cover losses from record crypto hack
reason: Corroborated by two sources and adds genuinely new facts — Binance reserving $6.34B of its own funds and roughly $3B in frozen assets — beyond the initial hack coverage.

sources.summary: Binance said it reserved its own funds to cover the $6.3 billion hack, including freezes of roughly $3 billion in stolen assets.
Investigators tie the $6B Binance hack to North Korea. Here's how hot-wallet signing infrastructure was compromised and where funds went.
